title: Referral, commissions và anti-fraud
scope_items: Target 1 (No immediate qualified reward on pending payment): Settlement engine checks payment status ('paid' required) and hold periods. When payment status is pending, unpaid, or failed, status is held in 'pending' and zero credits are awarded.

Target 2 (Self-referral held for review): Anti-fraud engine evaluates 4 identity signals (workspace ID matching, user ID matching, client IP address matching, and device fingerprint matching). When any match occurs, fraud_check_passed is set to false, status transitions to 'fraud_flagged', zero credits are awarded, and an audit event is logged for admin review.

Target 3 (Replay/refund reverses once): Chargeback and refund reversals are strictly idempotent. The first refund transitions a rewarded referral to 'revoked' and debits credits. Subsequent refund replays return the existing revoked record and emit idempotent skipped events with zero duplicate debits.
Referral Tiers & Progression: Full 4-tier progression (Bronze 1.0x, Silver 1.5x at 5 referrals, Gold 2.0x at 15 referrals, Platinum 3.0x + 10% recurring commissions at 30 referrals).
Promotional Service: Promo code redemption engine supporting active/expired windows, max redemption limits, multi-use vs single-use codes, and credit granting with audit logging.
Viral Prompts & Growth Funnel: Growth prompt trigger evaluation on key actions (export, publish, win) with rate-limiting, and funnel conversion calculation (clicks -> signups -> paid conversions).
